watchOut: Under 2.20% is a starting rate; ask what your volume gets.
Advance rate is not stated on the pages we read.
owner: Member-owned cooperative, governed by elected member-carriers (since 1958, per TCE)
name: Transport Clearings East (TCE)
summary: A member-owned freight factoring cooperative that pays year-end dividends to member carriers.
differentiator: The only cooperative we found: carriers own it, so pricing is set to cover costs rather than profit, and members get year-end dividends. It publishes a starting rate under 2.20% with no setup fee, no monthly minimum and no long-term contract, but not the rate a small carrier should expect.

terms.recourse: Offers both recourse and non-recourse structures
terms.otherFees: No setup costs and no hidden fees; year-end dividends to members
terms.speed: Funding as soon as the next business day

costModel.note: The "under 2.20%" starting rate, the best case. Rates for small carriers are not published.

bestFor: Carriers who want next-day funding and a share of the profits.
skipIf: You need same-day funding; TCE states next business day.
